title: MRC policy on embedding diversity in research design
description: Requires MRC-funded studies using human participants, samples or data, and animal studies, to build diversity into research design, considering characteristics such as sex, gender, age, ethnicity and socio-economic position.

title: NIHR-INCLUDE guidance
publisher: NIHR Clinical Research Network INCLUDE project
description: Defines under-served groups, identifies points in the research process where inclusion can be improved, and offers a framework of questions for funders, researchers and delivery teams.

title: NIHR RSS Research Inclusion Toolkit
description: Eight domains across the research lifecycle, including public involvement and community engagement and budgeting for inclusion. Explains how inclusion supports NIHR funding requirements.
stages: Funding application;Study design;Co-production and PPIE;Recruitment and retention;Data collection;Analysis;Reporting and dissemination

title: Payment guidance for researchers and professionals
publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Research
description: A five-step budgeting process, suggested payment rates, expenses, benefits and tax guidance for paying public contributors. Advises costing involvement at the earliest stage. Check NIHR for a newer version and current rates.

title: INCLUDE Ethnicity Framework
description: Four key questions with worksheets to help trial teams decide which ethnic groups to include and how to reduce barriers. Designed to be worked through with patient and public partners at the design stage, before funding is in place.
stages: Funding application;Study design;Recruitment and retention;Co-production and PPIE

title: Improving Trial Diversity
description: A hub of frameworks and guidance for including under-served groups in trials, including deciding which ethnic groups a trial needs, collecting ethnicity data, and INCLUDE frameworks for socio-economic disadvantage and impaired capacity to consent.
stages: Funding application;Study design;Recruitment and retention;Data collection

title: Trial Forge Guidance 3: recruiting and retaining individuals from ethnic minority groups
publisher: Dawson, Banister, Biggs et al., Trials 23: 672
description: Practical guidance to support better practice in recruiting and retaining people from ethnic minority groups in randomised trials.

title: Making it easier for trial teams to design inclusive trials
publisher: Aberdeen Centre for Evaluation, University of Aberdeen
description: Completed PhD project on taking an intersectional lens to trial design and delivery. Findings were translated into practical resources for trial teams, hosted on Trial Forge.

title: Increasing participation of Black, Asian and minority ethnic groups in health and social care research
description: A framework covering which communities to involve, effective PPI, recruitment, culturally competent research conduct, feedback to participants and preparing a grant application.
stages: Funding application;Co-production and PPIE;Recruitment and retention;Reporting and dissemination

title: Involving Young People: A toolkit for peer research
description: A practical guide to recruiting, training and paying young people as peer researchers, with remuneration models, budget examples, ethics and safeguarding, fieldwork, analysis and impact.
stages: Funding application;Co-production and PPIE;Recruitment and retention;Ethics;Data collection;Analysis;Reporting and dissemination

title: UK Standards for Public Involvement
publisher: NIHR, Health and Care Research Wales, Public Health Agency NI, Chief Scientist Office
description: Six standards with reflective questions to improve public involvement: inclusive opportunities, working together, support and learning, communications, impact and governance. Link is to a commentary on their development.

title: Relevance of sex, gender and diversity in research
description: Asks applicants to reflect on sex, gender and diversity when planning every project and address them where relevant. Provides a checklist and subject-specific examples.

title: STRIDE: Supporting Recruitment and Retention Improvements for Diverse Ethnicities
description: Helps trial teams using the INCLUDE Ethnicity Framework to identify representative proportions of ethnic groups and evidence-based recruitment and retention strategies.

title: Diversity in clinical research toolkit
publisher: MRCT Center of Brigham and Women's Hospital and Harvard
description: Logic models, checklists and example participant materials to improve participant diversity in clinical research.

title: DISTINCT project: demographic questions for health research
publisher: Institute of Cancer Research CTSU and Queen Mary University of London CPTU
description: A set of 15 demographic questions developed with patients and the public so studies can monitor whether they include people from all backgrounds. Mostly drawn from national surveys to allow comparison; reported in Lidington et al. (2026).
study_types: Clinical trials and studies;Population, observational and qualitative research

title: Egality Health
description: A community engagement agency linking health and life sciences organisations with under-served communities. Listed for information; not endorsed by REG.

title: Assessing research involving inclusion health communities
description: Co-produced guides for research ethics committees on assessing research with marginalised or under-served communities.

title: EDIS practical tools and guidance
description: Practical EDI tools for science and health research, including DAISY question guidance on how to ask diversity questions.

title: Integrating sex and gender in health research
description: Free online training modules on sex and gender in biomedical research, primary data collection and secondary data analysis.

title: Gendered Innovations
description: Resources across disciplines on taking sex, gender and intersectionality into account in research.

title: NIH Policy on Sex as a Biological Variable
description: Expects sex to be accounted for in the design, analysis and reporting of vertebrate animal and human studies.
study_types: Laboratory and animal research;Clinical trials and studies

title: NC3Rs Experimental Design Assistant
description: A free tool for designing robust animal experiments, including planning experiments that use female and male animals.

title: Sex Inclusive Research Framework (SIRF)
description: A framework to assess whether an in vivo research proposal takes appropriate account of sex, with an online self-assessment.

title: EDI Toolkit: Research
description: A guide to building sex, gender and other diversity aspects into the research process, developed to support Horizon Europe requirements.

title: EDI Resource Bank
description: An open-access database of EDI reports and initiatives from universities and organisations, some relevant to research design.

title: NCRM online learning resources
description: Online tutorials, videos and publications on social science research methods, including sex, gender, ethnic diversity and socio-economic classification.

title: SAGER guidelines
description: Guidelines for reporting sex and gender information in study design, data analysis, results and interpretation.

title: A practical guide to inclusive research
description: An introductory guide to inclusive practice in online research, written by user experience researchers outside health research. Not peer reviewed.

title: UCSF resources on diversity in research participation
description: Listed by MRC without a link. The report and webcast could not be found on 20 October 2026.

title: Inclusive Research Hub
publisher: Inclusive Research Collective and University of Bristol
description: An open learning resource bringing together concepts, frameworks and practical resources on inclusive research, in six modules from contextualising research and forming a question to collecting and analysing data and communicating results.
stages: Study design;Data collection;Analysis;Reporting and dissemination;Training and learning

title: Toolkit for patient-focused therapy development
publisher: NCATS, US National Institutes of Health
description: Helps patient groups engage throughout the development of drugs, biologics and medical devices. Limited relevance to race equity.
